{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out baseline -999 (QC failure)
df_filtered = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Handle assay_batch: batch B values are in µg/L, need to divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup["biomarker_final_corrected"] = df_dedup["biomarker_final"].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final_corrected"] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute change in biomarker (final - baseline)
df_dedup["biomarker_change"] = df_dedup["biomarker_final_corrected"] - df_dedup["biomarker_baseline"]

# Step 5: Compute average change
avg_change = df_dedup["biomarker_change"].mean()

# Print results
print(f'Number of patients after filtering and deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')
print(f'Average biomarker change (ng/mL): {avg_change:.4f}')

# Return the average change
avg_change"}
